1.what: screw spacing on the front of the right X end, top edge of the upper head to top edge of the lower head (= center spacing)

2.what: head diameter of the upper X end front screw; it takes a 2.5 mm hex key, so it is an M3 socket head (nominal head 5.5)

3.what: width of the flat face with the two screws, from the raised belt strip to the first step, halfway between the screws

4.what: re-measured: left to right, from the center of the X end front screws to the inner face of the FRONT right upright (first try 50.96)

5.what: front to back, from the X end face with the two screws to the front face of the front right upright (the screw face is behind it)

6.what: at Z 50: from the bed surface up to the center of the lower X end front screw; the lower screw is 53 mm over the nozzle tip

7.what: from the bed surface up to the bottom edge of the top corner plate on the front of the right upright; at Z 297 the plate starts 48 mm over the tip

8.what: ESTIMATE (hard to reach): the top edge of the bottom corner plate is about 10 mm under the bed surface

9.what: head fully right: from the right face of the BLTouch mount tab to the inner face of the front right upright

9b.what: head fully right: the BLTouch mount tab is 8 mm behind the front face of the front right upright

10.what: head fully right: clearance from the lower X end screw to the tool head motor in front of it

10b.what: head fully right: clearance in front of the upper screw, 25 mm or more (almost clear)
